# Quiet Utility

## Overview

One screen of a working tool on white: slate frames around white panels on visible 1px lines, tabular figures for money, a muted slate accent for the primary action and status colours that carry meaning only. A screen for daily repeated work: visible lines, tabular money and status colours that mean something, with one slate accent for the primary action.

Generated by web-stylebook-mcp from the quiet-utility style, with brutalist-grid's accent as the secondary overlay. Values are the starting tokens compose_design_tokens returns without a visual contract. This file describes the light theme.

Visual profile: one sans with tabular figures, white panels in slate frames, queue-and-record working rhythm.

## Colors

Token names follow DESIGN.md conventions; the name in parentheses is the compose_design_tokens role.

- **primary** (text) `#1f2328`: Body text and headings.
- **on-primary** (textInverse) `#ffffff`: Text on a primary (ink) fill.
- **secondary** (textMuted) `#67696d`: Secondary text: captions, metadata, helper text.
- **surface** (canvas) `#ffffff`: Page background.
- **surface-container** (surface) `#f8f8f9`: Panels and cards.
- **surface-container-high** (surfaceRaised) `#f4f4f4`: Raised surfaces such as inputs, menus, and popovers.
- **surface-variant** (surfaceMuted) `#ededee`: Muted fills such as hover rows, wells, and disabled areas.
- **outline** (borderStrong) `#a5a7a9`: Control boundaries that must stay visible.
- **outline-variant** (border) `#cecfd0`: Dividers and decorative rules.
- **accent** (accent) `#526371`: The style's identity accent.
- **on-accent** (accentText) `#ffffff`: Text on the accent.
- **accent-secondary** (accentSecondary) `#d72600`: Secondary accent for selection and secondary surfaces, not the primary action.
- **on-accent-secondary** (accentSecondaryText) `#ffffff`: Text on the secondary accent.
- **focus** (focus) `#526371`: Focus indicator.

Status colors (positive, caution, critical, info) are not in this file; take them from compose_design_tokens.

## Typography

Intended type: One sans at 400, 500 and 600 with tabular, slashed-zero figures. These levels are starting points; confirm the faces against the intended type before use.

- **display**: system-ui, sans-serif, 3rem, line height 1.2
- **heading**: system-ui, sans-serif, 2rem, line height 1.2
- **subheading**: system-ui, sans-serif, 1.125rem, line height 1.5
- **body**: system-ui, sans-serif, 1rem, line height 1.5
- **small**: system-ui, sans-serif, 0.875rem, line height 1.5
- **caption**: system-ui, sans-serif, 0.75rem, line height 1.5
- **data**: ui-monospace, monospace, 0.875rem, line height 1.5

## Layout

Spacing tokens: 1 4px, 2 8px, 3 12px, 4 16px, 6 24px, 8 32px, gutter 12px, row 32px.

### Page structure

- **Opening:** No hero: the first screen is one working tool on white. A two-column head (minmax(0, 1fr) beside a 540px column) puts a left-aligned 1.875rem heading and a muted one-line brief on the left and the month in a 1px-lined, 12px-radius panel on the right: a count, a 1.75rem tabular total, a 10px stacked bar and a legend of 8px status dots. The queue and the open record start directly below.
- **Grid:** A queue beside the open record: a minmax(0, 5fr) / minmax(0, 7fr) split with a 16px gap. Each side is a slate shell (4px padding, 16px radius, #edf2f4) holding a white panel with a visible 1px edge and a 12px radius; inside the record, properties sit in three equal columns and the match in a three-cell ruled strip. Below 1079px and 899px the split stacks to one column.
- **Density:** High enough for daily repeated work: queue rows at 10px 16px 11px padding, group heads at 40px minimum, 32px tokens and buttons in the shell head, 16px between shells and a 4px spacing unit. Whitespace groups related controls; it never stages a single claim.
- **Type scale:** One sans, Inter, at 400, 500 and 600. The display size, 1.875rem at 600 with -0.024em tracking and 1.15 line-height (1.625rem below 759px), appears once per screen; body is 1rem/1.5, supplier names take 500, meta text sits at 0.875rem and labels at 0.75rem. Amounts are tabular-nums slashed-zero so columns of money line up; references are proportional-nums slashed-zero.
- **Section order:**
  1. Top bar with the product mark, the organisation and the signed-in person
  2. Head: the screen title and brief beside the month total, stacked bar and status legend
  3. The queue: segmented view switch, filter token and count, then rows grouped by who has to act
  4. The open record: properties, the three-way match strip and the line items with the one line that differs
  5. The approval trail as a real sequence, with approve and dispute actions and a reason field
- **Signature moves:**
  - Slate shell around a white panel: Orientation: controls that change the list live in the frame, the data lives in the panel, and the two never blur together.
  - Queue grouped by who has to act: Triage: the person sees first what waits on them and what it is worth, then everything else in the same rhythm.
  - Three-way match strip and approval trail: Proof: the reason to approve or dispute is on screen as figures and a sequence, not as a summary sentence.

### Must-haves on the main dashboard

The style restyles these but never removes them; every first-screen item goes in the opening.

- **Current status**: On the first screen: in the opening section or above it, before the first scroll. Lead with the state right now: status labels, health indicators, or key metric values with their labels.
- **What changed**: On the first screen: in the opening section or above it, before the first scroll. Show what changed: deltas against a stated comparison period, recent events with relative times, or an activity list.

## Shapes

Corner radius: sm 2px, md 4px, lg 8px.

## Components

Each component names its text color and the background it sits on.

- **body-canvas**: primary on surface
- **body-panel**: primary on surface-container
- **muted-panel**: secondary on surface-container
- **button-primary**: on-accent on accent
- **selection**: on-accent-secondary on accent-secondary
- **focus-ring**: focus — Focus ring color.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do: Remove soft elevation; separate surfaces with rules, borders, or flat fills, as this style does. (style rule shadow-blur)
- Do: Use flat fills; keep gradients out of sections, cards, buttons, and decorative shapes. (style rule gradient-fill)
- Do: Keep the corner radius of cards, panels, buttons, inputs, and images at 16px or less. (style rule corner-radius)
- Do: Set the body role in a sans face. (style rule typeface)
- Don't: Centered hero over a gradient blob (pattern gradient-blob-hero)
- Don't: All-text centered stack (pattern centered-stack-hero)
- Don't: Stock-photo hero (pattern stock-photo-hero)
- Don't: Logo strip (pattern logo-strip)
- Don't: Generic “trusted by” band (pattern trusted-by-band)
- Don't: Icon feature cards (pattern icon-feature-grid)
- Don't: Testimonial carousel (pattern testimonial-carousel)
- Don't: Generic closing CTA banner (pattern closing-cta-banner)
- Don't: Generic SaaS page skeleton (pattern generic-saas-skeleton)
